text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day of the Hanshin JF—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... There are so many people.
The atmosphere is completely different from my debut race.
Wait, is today some kind of special day?

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Who knows... But let's cheer our hardest!
With this many people around,
Yukino-chan's bound to be nervous—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah-wa-wa-wa-wa-wa-wa-wa-wa-wa...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Still, the atmosphere is completely different
from her debut race...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I can tell. The passion radiating from them
is on a completely different level. And besides...

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ufu.
Now then, shall I go claim 1st place?

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: "Look at you actin' all composed. Expectations for us are low, ya know? Well, that just makes blowin' ya away all the more satisfyin'!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone running with us is so confident...
They're all just so cool!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Can I really run properly
in the middle of all this!?
choice_data_list: Let's head back to the waiting room for now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was meant to calm Yukino Bijin down,
but there was another reason as well—

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha.
Jeez, look at that face you're making~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Mifuyu-chan!?
Why are you here...!?

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Trainer invited me!
They even sent over everything, like the Shinkansen tickets and all!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ehh?!
Is that really true?!
choice_data_list: I thought talking to Mifuyu-san might cheer me up.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
!
For my sake...

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
"It just so happened to be my rest day, too.
So I flew right over here!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right. Figure skating practice...
Thank you so much for taking the time to come out.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Wait! I'm actually mad
that my Trainer contacted you!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hwah?!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
This is where you've gotta dig deep, right?
Of course I'm gonna cheer you on!
'Cause Yuki-chan's tough enough to hang in there~!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Listen, Yuki-chan. I don't know the first thing about racing, but... I like to think I know you!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: You'll be fine, Yuki-chan! You're suuuper gonna run so cool out there!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Mifuyu-chaaan...!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Or rather, you can't run uncool
right in front of my eyes, can you?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Heheh... Yeah!
Really—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'm all fired up now.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Mifuyu-chan came all the way out here to watch,
I can't go looking pathetic in front of her!
choice_data_list: Time to show you how cool I am.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yeah!
